title: What If Earth Stopped Orbiting the Sun?
altTitles: Earth Would Fall Into the Sun in 65 Days
65 Days to the Sun: What If Earth Stopped Moving?
description: If Earth stopped moving sideways, it would fall straight into the Sun in about 65 days: Venus's orbit on day 41, Mercury's on day 57, torn apart on day 64. Real orbital physics; the boiling-ocean details are model estimates. Sources in pinned comment. #whatif #space #sun
